_note: Radu's own runs, read on Tuesday 17 November 2026 at about 3:30pm with plugin 0.6.0 (--unit work): the standup for that day, for the full week of 9 to 15 November, and for 1 to 17 November. Real commits and real token counts, shown on the homepage at his request. The day was chosen because it shows the most: commits, merged pull requests, and work with no commit yet. Cost is at Anthropic's list prices of 2026-11-03, one price per model; the Codex model has no price row and is shown as unpriced. Each update follows his style file and is also written in the five built-in voices, turned up at his request. Four Romanian project names are shown in English so the example reads the same for everyone: My Pension (cat-vine-pensia), pension-meter (pensiometru), Jungle Cards (cartile-pe-fata) and Cotroceni Conference (conferinta-de-la-cotroceni). vibe-check is listed as personal in his settings and is left out. Nothing else is changed.
